stages.title: Immersion
stages.description: Listen to trusted Hawaiian-language audio without turning it into a quiz.

stages.title: Sentence Patterns
stages.description: Study source-checked Hawaiian sentence structure, then test what you can identify.

stages.title: Vocabulary in Context
stages.description: Planned: grow vocabulary through sentences and meaningful use.

units.title: Foundations: Sound & Writing
units.description: Build accurate Hawaiian spelling habits before vocabulary and grammar become larger. ʻOkina and kahakō are meaningful parts of spelling, not optional decoration.
outcomes: Recognize the ʻokina as a consonant/glottal stop
Type source-checked Hawaiian words with the ʻokina and kahakō in the right places
Notice that missing marks can point to a different Hawaiian form

lessons.title: ʻOkina & Kahakō
lessons.summary: Practice core words plus Hawaiʻi Island place names through repair, study, and recall.

units.title: Immersion: Listening Library
units.description: Use several trusted listening formats: structured lessons, short pronunciation audiograms, conversational podcasts, and the legacy HAW 101 archive.
outcomes: Become more comfortable hearing Hawaiian across different source types
Use short place-name audiograms to connect spelling with sound
Choose long-form or short-form listening without affecting mastery scores

lessons.title: Curated Immersion Library
lessons.summary: Explore structured video lessons, short UH Hilo pronunciation audiograms, learner conversation, and the HAW 101 archive.

units.title: Sentence Foundations
units.description: Move from source-checked sentence study into recognition, partial recall, full recall, and spaced review.
outcomes: Notice that Hawaiian sentence order does not have to mirror English
Identify key parts and verbal markers in source-checked examples
Produce familiar sourced sentences from memory and revisit misses later

lessons.title: Pepeke Painu: Study → Recognize → Recall
lessons.summary: Study sourced examples, identify their structure, then move into partial and full typed recall with spaced review.

units.title: Vocabulary in Context
units.description: Planned: learn new vocabulary through source-checked sentences and situations instead of isolated word lists.
outcomes: Use familiar words in meaningful situations
